# SI020 — verdict-before-policy-pin-check

A verdict must not be stored before the pinned policy hash is checked.

## Why

Without the check, validators can judge a different policy version than the one the incident pinned.

## Bad

```python
self.verdicts[incident_id] = record  # no hash check
```

## Good

```python
if policy.text_hash != inc.policy_hash:
    raise Exception('POLICY_DRIFT')
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI020 -- reason
```
